why: this branch changes shared code in tt_bio/tenstorrent.py (TriangleAttention gate/output biases + transpose_bias, AttentionPairBias kq_norm, the 2-factor SwiGLU transition, no_residual), so every model that rides those blocks is re-gated before the merge ask

openfold3.note: the 18 skips are keys qb1's uncommitted ~/of3_ref_out.pkl does not carry (7 of 17 present). Before tests/of3_golden.py those were 11 KeyError failures that read as a regression in whatever branch was checked out.

test_protenix_confidence::test_confidenc.attribution: NOT this branch: with tt_bio/tenstorrent.py checked out from origin/main the same test asserts the identical 0.9807056858828267, so the branch does not perturb this path

transient.test_protenix_trunk_class::test_protenix: failed the first run on a 900s subprocess timeout while three jobs shared the host; passes in 11.5s on a quiet host

code_reading: every shared-code change is either a new kwarg defaulting to the previous behaviour (transpose_bias=True, a_to_b_gate=True, no_residual=False, fp32_softmax=False) or an optional weight read only when the checkpoint carries it (linear_g.bias, linear_o.bias, proj_a.bias, proj_b.bias, query_layer_norm.weight). The one unconditional addition, _bias_scale = 1.0, is overwritten inside the only branch (compute_pair_bias) that uses it.
